caption:
Koko loves a long walk, but lately the soles of her feet feel burning and tingly.

Burning or tingling in the sole often involves nerves rather than muscles. Tight toe boxes, long hours standing and tight calves are a few common contributors, and the cause differs from person to person.

Hybi's 1-minute foot care: check your shoes are roomy, wall calf stretch 30 seconds × 3, ankle circles 10 each way, and check your soles before bed.

Both feet affected, feeling getting duller, or diabetes are all good reasons to see your GP or physio. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
